query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scaleup_analyses (
  id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  formulation_version_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  lab_scale JSON,
  pilot_scale JSON,
  target_scale JSON,
  reaction_type VARCHAR(100),
  rate_constant DECIMAL(20, 10),
  activation_energy DECIMAL(20, 10),
  reaction_order DECIMAL(10, 2),
  heat_generation_rate DECIMAL(20, 10),
  cooling_capacity_lab DECIMAL(20, 10),
  cooling_capacity_pilot DECIMAL(20, 10),
  temperature_rise_prediction DECIMAL(10, 2),
  mixing_time_lab DECIMAL(10, 2),
  mixing_time_pilot DECIMAL(10, 2),
  reynolds_number_lab DECIMAL(20, 2),
  reynolds_number_pilot DECIMAL(20, 2),
  power_per_volume_lab DECIMAL(20, 10),
  power_per_volume_pilot DECIMAL(20, 10),
  overall_risk_score DECIMAL(5, 2),
  risk_level VARCHAR(50),
  identified_risks JSON,
  process_modifications JSON,
  equipment_recommendations JSON,
  control_strategy_changes JSON,
  additional_testing_needed JSON,
  analyzed_by VARCHAR(255),
  analyzed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_org_formulation (organization_id, formulation_version_id)
);
